name: Kenji Tanaka
bio:
Kenji Tanaka's journey into motorsport IT began unexpectedly. After graduating with a degree in Information Technology from the University of Tokyo, he initially worked for a large electronics corporation. However, a chance encounter with a former racing engineer sparked his interest in applying his skills to the fast-paced world of racing.

He joined Ipiranga Racing ten years ago, initially as a junior systems administrator, quickly rising through the ranks due to his dedication and sharp problem-solving abilities. Kenji is known for his meticulous approach to data security and his insistence on implementing cutting-edge analytical tools. He believes a robust and innovative IT infrastructure is critical to giving Ipiranga Racing a competitive edge, both on and off the track.

Kenji's demanding nature stems from his unwavering commitment to excellence. He is not afraid to challenge conventional thinking and push his team to explore new possibilities, even if it means long hours and complex problem-solving. He's also fiercely loyal to Ipiranga Racing, seeing the team's success as his own.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: Kenji is of average height, with a wiry build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten code snippets.
Insists on using a vintage mechanical keyboard, despite the office's preference for quieter models.
Drinks green tea exclusively, brewed using a traditional Japanese teapot.
